notes: Bank holding company 10-K for 2024. Every Item of the form, including 1C, 6, 9C and 16, has one body heading, so nothing is absent. The contents list, which prints the Part labels on the same rows as some Items, is not labeled. Item 6 'Reserved' has no body; it is labeled and not marked incorporated, as in the earlier sets. Item 7A only points to the Market Risk section of MD&A and is marked incorporated. Item 9A holds the auditors' report on internal control. The filing ends at Signatures (line 3278). Incorporated (unscored): Items 1B, 4, 7A, 9, 9C, 11 to 14 and 16. Items 9B (trading arrangements) and 10 (insider trading policy) have text of their own and are not marked. Both labelers agreed on every label.
